style: clean modern 3D-rendered animation in the style of designer vinyl collectible toys: smooth matte surfaces, soft studio global illumination, crisp edges, gentle pastel palette, polished and bright — NO watercolor texture, NO painterly strokes, NO grain, NO muddy shadows.
stage: Split-format voice-call skit: two separate rooms, never in one frame. SHASHA'S ROOM: bright clean white-and-pink gaming room — desk against the window wall (pre-dawn dark-blue sky outside), white gaming PC tower with two pink front fans on the desk's left end, dual monitors with a colorful MOBA game, pink keyboard, one blue energy can on the right end, tall white-pink gaming chair, star-pattern rug under desk and chair. XIAOBAI'S ROOM: warm cream-and-mint bedroom desk — laptop and milk tea on a white desk by the window, plush toys on a low shelf, fairy lights. Real China, 2026.

characters.identity_desc: SHA-SHA, adult woman: dark skin, exact platinum-blonde braided buns, multiple metallic earrings and necklace, patterned gray jacket, pale tulle skirt; exact model-sheet proportions
characters.voice_desc: adult female Mandarin with a strong exaggerated northeastern (dongbei) comedic accent. Two registers with a HARD FALL between them: while bragging she is LOUD, booming, swaggering street-boss energy, almost shouting; at the collapse her voice CRACKS into a squealing falsetto yelp then instantly deflates into a breathy half-dead comic whimper, air leaking between words. The tonal crash IS the joke
